description: Somos Stellar Minds of UMES, un equipo de Guatemala con entusiasmo por la ciencia, la tecnología y la exploración espacial. Participamos en el NASA Space Apps Challenge con curiosidad, creatividad y ganas de colaborar para convertir ideas en soluciones innovadoras. Nos interesa aprender y aportar nuestros conocimientos para enfrentar desafíos relacionados con el espacio y nuestro planeta.
summary: Space Farm is an educational strategy and survival game set on Mars, created by the UMES team. Players manage a colony and explore a procedurally generated map with a rover to discover iron and ice deposits and expand their base. To survive, they must balance the production and consumption of energy, oxygen, water, and food while managing storage, astronauts, upgrades, and repairs. The rover transports resources from facilities to the colony’s warehouse, while environmental conditions challenge the player’s planning. Through interactive decisions, the game introduces STEM concepts such as space exploration, life-support systems, and responsible resource management. It is inspired by real space missions, but simplifies their processes for educational purposes; all resource values are game units.
details:
Space Farm is a 2D educational strategy and survival game set on Mars, developed by the UMES team using Unity and C#. Players manage a colony, explore a procedurally generated Martian map, and send a rover to discover iron and ice deposits. These resources are used to build and upgrade facilities, organize astronauts, and manage the collection and storage of oxygen, water, food, and minerals. Players must also monitor energy consumption, repair structures, and plan the expansion of their base.

The project introduces young people to STEM concepts through interactive systems and decisions. Players explore ideas related to space exploration, limited resources, energy generation, and life-support systems. The game’s values and processes are educational simplifications, not technical predictions of a real mission.

Space Farm combines resource management, exploration, construction, and progression in an accessible experience. Each playthrough features a different map, and player decisions affect the colony’s development. The game was built in Unity and prepared as a WebGL build so people can play it in a browser through a link.
